piezas.instruccion_en: On the bottle label only, make the small brand word 'amua' above 'VITALDROPS' much less noticeable: soften it with a light blur and low contrast so it blends into the yellow label and is not readable at a glance. Do not remove or change the bottle, the label color, 'VITALDROPS' or any other label detail. Keep everything else exactly the same: women, poses, headline, subtitle, handwritten notes, seal, icons, colors, layout and framing.
